mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of haloperidol, increasing haloperidol levels; both drugs prolong QT interval and have negative inotropic effects, increasing cardiotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor ECG, QTc interval, and haloperidol levels; consider alternative antipsychotic or calcium channel blocker; reduce haloperidol dose if necessary and monitor for increased extrapyramidal and cardiac side effects.
